 BLS Polymers to launch INR 255 crore IPO on 27 October with price band of INR 142–150 per share
 #Taxation & Finance News #Commercial #India 
 Last Updated : 22 Oct 2026 
 Share

 Synopsis
 BLS Polymers will open its INR 255 crore initial public offering (IPO) for subscription on 27 October, with the price band fixed at INR 142–150 per share. The issue, comprising 1.7 crore fresh equity shares, will close on 29 October, while bidding for anchor investors is scheduled for 26 October. The company plans to allocate INR 77.56 crore towards expanding its manufacturing facility and increasing production capacity, and INR 89.5 crore towards working capital requirements. The remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. Established in 1991, the company manufactures specialised polymer compounds for sectors including telecommunications, power, railways, water and oil and gas distribution. It reported revenue of INR 349.43 crore and profit after tax of INR 27.01 crore in FY26. 
 Representative image
 BLS Polymers will launch its INR 255 crore initial public offering (IPO) on 27 October, offering investors an opportunity to subscribe to 1.7 crore fresh equity shares at a price band of INR 142–150 per share. The public issue will close on 29 October, with bidding for anchor investors scheduled for 26 October. At the upper end of the price band, the company expects to raise INR 255 crore. At the lower end, the same number of shares would generate approximately INR 241.4 crore. 
According to the company's red herring prospectus, INR 77.56 crore of the proceeds will be allocated towards expanding its manufacturing facility and increasing the production capacity of selected existing products. Another INR 89.5 crore will be used to meet working capital requirements, while the balance will be deployed for general corporate purposes. The two specified allocations together account for INR 167.06 crore, or approximately 65.5% of the issue size at the upper price band, leaving around INR 87.94 crore for general corporate purposes. 
BLS Polymers manufactures custom-formulated polymer compounds used in a range of industrial applications, including telecommunications, power, railways, water infrastructure, and oil and gas distribution. Its products cater to sectors that require specialised polymer materials for their respective operational needs. The company operates a manufacturing facility in Goa with an installed capacity of 35,251 metric tonnes per annum (MTPA). 
Its distribution and export network extends beyond its manufacturing base, with operations across 23 states and Union Territories in India. The company also exports its products to 13 countries, including the United States, Germany, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Bangladesh. Established in 1991, BLS Polymers is part of the BLS Group, which has business interests spanning textiles, education, polymers, visa and consular services, banking business correspondent services and e-governance. The group's presence across these sectors provides the broader corporate context for the polymer manufacturer's operations. 
For the financial year ended March 2026, BLS Polymers reported revenue from operations of INR 349.43 crore and profit after tax (PAT) of INR 27.01 crore, translating into a PAT margin of approximately 7.7%. In the quarter ended June 2026, the company recorded revenue of INR 107.03 crore and PAT of INR 10.23 crore, implying a margin of around 9.6%. Unistone Capital is the book-running lead manager for the IPO, while KFin Technologies Ltd has been appointed registrar to the issue. The funds raised through the offering are intended to support manufacturing expansion, strengthen working capital availability and meet the company's general corporate requirements.
